title: The Case-Discussion Debrief Synthesizer
description: Takes notes from a case discussion that just happened and synthesizes a debrief document students can review afterward.
framing_paragraph: This recipe defines The Case-Discussion Debrief Synthesizer, a teaching-focused agent that fits the use case in the description above. Use it when that description matches what you want the agent to do in your course. The agent works best when its Instructions field is calibrated against two or three representative prompts before you share the resulting agent with students or colleagues.
